title: Acceptance
paragraphs: By creating an account on Yakın Çevrem you accept these terms of use and the privacy policy. If you don't accept them, you shouldn't use the app.

title: The service
paragraphs: Yakın Çevrem offers weekly schedules, status, meetups, messaging, a couple space and project tools for close friend groups and couples. The app is free; features may change, be added or be removed over time.

title: Your account
paragraphs: You must be at least {minimumAge} years old to create an account.
Give accurate information and don't impersonate anyone. Everyone uses their own account; you can't transfer yours.
You're responsible for keeping your password safe. If you think your account was used without permission, change your password and write to us.

title: Content and behaviour that are not allowed
paragraphs: Harassment, threats, bullying and hate speech.
Sharing someone else's personal information, photos or private conversations without their permission.
Nudity and sexual content; any abusive content involving children (reported to the authorities).
Encouraging violence, self-harm or illegal activity.
Spam, fraud, fake accounts and pretending to be someone else.
Trying to bypass the app's security, access other people's data or overload the service with automated tools.

title: Your content
paragraphs: Content you share belongs to you. You only give us the limited permission needed to store it, show it to the people you choose and provide the service.
You're responsible for the content you share.

title: Reports, blocking and moderation
paragraphs: You can block anyone who bothers you and report a person or content. The reported person isn't told who reported them.
Reports are reviewed by the app's moderators. Messages, comments or shared templates that break the rules may be removed, and accounts may be restricted for 1 day, 7 days, 30 days or indefinitely.
A restricted account can't send messages, comments or connection requests, create meetups or groups, or share templates. It can still view the app and download its data.
To appeal a restriction, write to {email}.

title: Closing your account
paragraphs: You can permanently delete your account at any time from Settings → Account.
We may close accounts for serious or repeated violations.

title: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: The app is provided "as is"; we don't guarantee it will work without interruptions or errors.
We aren't responsible for how users behave towards each other or for meetups outside the app.
We recommend keeping a copy of your important data with "Download my data".

title: Changes
paragraphs: If the terms change materially, the new version is shown in the app and your consent is asked. If you don't accept, you can delete your account.

title: Governing law and contact
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Türkiye.
Contact: {email}
